text:
anya-support: FYI customer (acme-localization) opened a high-priority ticket — they say translation quality for non-English outputs regressed after last rollout. They provided examples and want a repro.

acme-localization: Hi team — after the update yesterday our translate endpoint is returning odd phrasing and sometimes dropping polite particles in Portuguese and Indonesian. This impacts our UX. Examples below. Requesting a hotfix or revert.

anya-support: Copying examples from the customer (expected vs actual).
- Prompt: "Translate to Portuguese: 'Your order has shipped and will arrive in 3-5 business days.'"
  - Expected: "Seu pedido foi enviado e chegará em 3 a 5 dias úteis."
  - Actual: "Pedido enviado. Chega 3–5 dias."  (customer: too curt, missing polite register)

- Prompt: "Translate to Indonesian: 'Please confirm your delivery address.'"
  - Expected: "Tolong konfirmasi alamat pengiriman Anda."
  - Actual: "Konfirmasi alamat."  (customer: sounds like a command)

acme-localization: Also seeing occasional swapping of honorifics in Indonesian when original English uses 'please' vs 'kindly'. Not consistent but started right after canary.

devin-ml: Thanks — can you paste the full API call and model/version used by the customer? Need request_id and exact headers if available.

acme-localization: They called our proxy which forwards to Redwood API; we captured the outbound:

```
POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-4o",
  "input": "Translate to Portuguese: 'Your order has shipped and will arrive in 3-5 business days.'",
  "max_tokens": 60,
  "temperature": 0.0
}
```
Request ID from proxy: rwd-proxy-20260311-abc123

anya-support: Customer says they only started seeing this after the "release/2026-03-11/canary" promotion. ops-bot should have deploy info.

ops-bot: release/2026-03-11/canary promoted -> release/2026-03-11/stable at 03:08:27 UTC. Canaries: redwood-4o:v2 (kernel updates + small tokenization change).

sam-fw: If it's tokenization-related that could change spacing/punctuation and small register cues. Can we quickly rollback the model variant for the affected hosted fleet?

kevin-engineering: I can pin the default model route for the tenant to redwood-4o:v1 for now. That will take ~8 minutes to roll out. Need confirmation from product/ops.

maria-cs: Please do the pin. I'll tell the customer we have a mitigation in progress. Put the timeframe and mention we'll follow up with a postmortem.

devin-ml: I'll run a targeted eval set for politeness/register across PT/ID and run a diff between v1 and v2. Can someone share a small set of failing prompts (5-10) so I can automate quickly?

acme-localization: Sharing 6 prompts in a secure ticket — includes the two above plus some samples with 'please' vs no please.

kevin-engineering: Pin request accepted. Routing for acme-prod will be forced to redwood-4o:v1 now. ETA ~7 minutes.

ops-bot: Route update applied for tenant acme-prod -> redwood-4o:v1 at 03:21:05 UTC (propagation across edge nodes in progress).

anya-support: Customer notified about temporary pin. They've asked for root cause and timeline for permanent fix.

devin-ml: Quick note: the v2 change included a tokenizer patch to treat em dashes and non-ASCII spaces differently. That can affect phrase segmentation used by politeness heuristics. I'll bisect and run on our eval harness.

sam-fw: If tokenization is the root cause, we should consider rolling the tokenizer change behind an opt-in flag rather than global.

maria-cs: I'll track communications. Marking customer impact P1.

kevin-engineering: Repro steps for SRE/ML to run locally:
```
# minimal repro
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-4o","input":"Translate to Portuguese: \"Please reset my password.\"","temperature":0.0}'
```
Check outputs between redwood-4o:v1 and v2. Capture request_id header.
```
request_id: rwd-local-zz987
```

devin-ml: Good. I'll run that now against the canary image and v1. Will post diffs in this thread.

anya-support: Thanks team. Customer wants an ETA on permanent fix and whether there will be any regression tests added to prevent this class of break.

devin-ml: If it's tokenizer -> we'll add targeted regression tests for polite phrasing and a small translation sanity suite (PT/ID/AR) to CI. Can't promise timings yet but will update after bisect (~4 hours).

maria-cs: Noted. I'll give the customer a status update: we pinned their traffic back to the previous variant, investigating root cause, ETA for deeper update after ML analysis.

acme-localization: Appreciate the fast response and the temporary pin. Please keep us posted in the ticket.

sam-fw: Follow-ups: 1) run eval diff, 2) decide rollback vs patch, 3) add regression tests to pre-promote checklist. Adding to our release retro. :memo:

anya-support: Thread updated in ticket. Closing Slack loop for now — will reopen if any new customer-observed failures after pin.

devin-ml: Posting initial diff results in ticket in ~3.5 hours.

kevin-engineering: If anyone needs hot access to logs for the tenant, ping me and I'll share a short-lived S3 link.

maria-cs: Thanks all. :heart:
